calculators.name: Mortgage Calculator
calculators.shortDescription: Calculate your monthly mortgage payment including principal and interest, property taxes, homeowners insurance, PMI, and HOA fees with amortization schedule.

fields.label: Down Payment ($)
fields.helpText: Cash payment towards purchase (20% avoids PMI)

fields.label: Property Tax ($/year)
fields.helpText: Annual property tax assessed by local government (avg ~1.2%)

fields.label: PMI Rate (%)
fields.helpText: Private Mortgage Insurance required if down payment < 20%

fields.label: Other Costs ($/year)
fields.helpText: Flood insurance or other municipal special assessments

fields.label: Extra Monthly Payment ($)
fields.helpText: Additional monthly principal payment to accelerate payoff

outputs.label: Total Monthly Payment
outputs.formula: ((homePrice - downPayment) > 0 ? ((homePrice - downPayment) * ((interestRate / 100 / 12) * pow(1 + (interestRate / 100 / 12), loanTerm * 12)) / (pow(1 + (interestRate / 100 / 12), loanTerm * 12) - 1)) : 0) + (propertyTax / 12) + (homeInsurance / 12) + ((downPayment < homePrice * 0.2) ? ((homePrice - downPayment) * (pmiRate / 100 / 12)) : 0) + hoaFee + (otherCosts / 12) + extraPayment
outputs.description: Total monthly payment including P&I, taxes, insurance, and fees

outputs.label: Total Cost Over Loan Life
outputs.formula: (((homePrice - downPayment) * ((interestRate / 100 / 12) * pow(1 + (interestRate / 100 / 12), loanTerm * 12)) / (pow(1 + (interestRate / 100 / 12), loanTerm * 12) - 1)) * (loanTerm * 12)) + (propertyTax * loanTerm) + (homeInsurance * loanTerm) + (hoaFee * 12 * loanTerm) + (otherCosts * loanTerm)

calculators.name: Auto Loan Calculator
calculators.shortDescription: Calculate monthly auto loan payments, total interest, sales tax, fees, and total purchase cost with trade-in value support.

fields.label: Vehicle Price
fields.helpText: Negotiated purchase price of the vehicle

fields.label: Interest Rate (%)
fields.helpText: Annual Percentage Rate (APR) on the auto loan

fields.label: Trade-in Value
fields.helpText: Dealer trade-in allowance for your current vehicle

fields.label: Amount Owed on Trade-in
fields.helpText: Outstanding balance on existing trade-in loan

fields.label: Sales Tax Rate (%)
fields.helpText: State and local vehicle sales tax rate

fields.label: Title, Registration & Dealer Fees
fields.helpText: Documentation, title, plate and dealer registration fees

outputs.label: Monthly Payment
outputs.formula: ((autoPrice - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade) + (autoPrice * salesTaxRate / 100) + dealerFees - downPayment) > 0 ? ((autoPrice - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade) + (autoPrice * salesTaxRate / 100) + dealerFees - downPayment) * ((interestRate / 100 / 12) * pow(1 + (interestRate / 100 / 12), loanTermMonths)) / (pow(1 + (interestRate / 100 / 12), loanTermMonths) - 1)) : 0)

outputs.label: Total Loan Amount Financed
outputs.formula: max(0, autoPrice - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade) + (autoPrice * salesTaxRate / 100) + dealerFees - downPayment)

outputs.label: Total Loan Interest
outputs.formula: (((autoPrice - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade) + (autoPrice * salesTaxRate / 100) + dealerFees - downPayment) * ((interestRate / 100 / 12) * pow(1 + (interestRate / 100 / 12), loanTermMonths)) / (pow(1 + (interestRate / 100 / 12), loanTermMonths) - 1)) * loanTermMonths) - (autoPrice - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade) + (autoPrice * salesTaxRate / 100) + dealerFees - downPayment)

outputs.label: Total Vehicle Cost
outputs.formula: downPayment + (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade) + (((autoPrice - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade) + (autoPrice * salesTaxRate / 100) + dealerFees - downPayment) * ((interestRate / 100 / 12) * pow(1 + (interestRate / 100 / 12), loanTermMonths)) / (pow(1 + (interestRate / 100 / 12), loanTermMonths) - 1)) * loanTermMonths)

outputs.label: Projected Retirement Nest Egg
outputs.formula: currentSavings * pow(1 + (preRetireReturn / 100), max(1, retireAge - currentAge)) + ((annualIncome * savingsPercent / 100) * (pow(1 + (preRetireReturn / 100), max(1, retireAge - currentAge)) - 1) / (preRetireReturn / 100))

outputs.label: Estimated Monthly Retirement Income
outputs.formula: (currentSavings * pow(1 + (preRetireReturn / 100), max(1, retireAge - currentAge)) + ((annualIncome * savingsPercent / 100) * (pow(1 + (preRetireReturn / 100), max(1, retireAge - currentAge)) - 1) / (preRetireReturn / 100))) * 0.04 / 12
outputs.description: Based on standard 4% safe withdrawal rule
